Alouette® Cranberry Brie
By: Corrinne
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:01pm

Ingredients




1 package (13.2 oz. or 8 oz.) Alouette Baby Brie, Original
1 cup Ocean Spray® Cran-Fruit Cranberry Orange Sauce
2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar
3 teaspoons rum or orange extract
1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
2 tablespoons chopped pecans

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 450º F. 2 Remove top rind of Alouette Baby Brie leaving a 3" rim around the circumference of the cheese. 3 In a small bowl combine Cran-Fruit, brown sugar, extract and nutmeg. 4 Top Alouette Baby Brie with cranberry mixture and sprinkle with 2 tbsp. chopped pecans. 5 Place in an ovenproof dish and bake in a 450º F oven for 4-5 minutes. 6 Serve warm with assorted crackers or apple slices.

About


Nothing says holiday like cranberries! This recipe is just perfect, elegant and easy for the holiday season. Did we mention it's delicious!
